Instrument.name: Las Cumbres 2m Telescopes - FLOYDS Spectrograph
Instrument.description: The FLOYDS Spectrograph is an echelle spectrograph mounted on the Las Cumbres 2m Telescopes, designed to capture high-resolution spectra of astronomical objects. FLOYDS (Florida Low-Dispersion Optical Spectrograph) is capable of performing spectroscopy on a variety of celestial bodies, including stars, galaxies, and supernovae. It works by dispersing the light from a target into its component wavelengths, allowing astronomers to study the chemical composition, velocity, and physical properties of the object. The 2m telescopes provide sufficient aperture to gather light from faint objects, making the FLOYDS spectrograph an essential tool for exoplanet research, stellar studies, and galactic dynamics.
